Use case: stylized-concept. One standalone Goldmund house warrior illustration, transparent PNG, portrait 2:3. The FIRST attached image is the binding PAINTING STYLE reference only: match its gently simplified large readable forms, softly painted thin contours, matte muted colours, restrained shading and fine uniform dry gouache pigment grain. The SECOND attached image is this house's HERALDRY and PALETTE reference only; incorporate its actual motif tastefully into wearable practical equipment and textiles. Fine well-kept clothing, excellent armour workmanship, believable articulated joints, functional weapons and straps. Richness through design and textiles, NOT photoreal shiny metal. One human warrior, complete figure from highest plume to both feet; for a mounted warrior include the ENTIRE horse and all hooves. Leave clear transparent margin on every side and above every weapon. Quiet composed but individual posture. True transparent exterior and open gaps, opaque body, no environment, ground, cast shadow, pedestal, paper rectangle, gradient, glow or halo. No text, labels, floating coat of arms, separate heraldic badge, realistic face, CGI, comic black outlines, huge spikes, oversized pauldrons or fantasy anatomy.
HOUSE: Arenberg. CLASS: Oraner.
DESIGN: Mounted prestigious ORANER on a GOLDEN Aurelianer stallion (third image is horse breed reference only). Horse coat honey-gold, mane deeper gold, never white. Both horse and rider in a quiet walking three-quarter side view facing left. Noble blue cloth barding with golden horse emblem and wheat border, saddle, bridle, stirrups. Rider wears finely fluted gold-toned plate, royal dusty-blue short mantle, tall blue-and-gold feather fan on a closed armet. Sword held safely upright, small blue heater shield on other arm with a single gold stallion. Keep horse natural and elegant, all four hooves inside canvas, rider and horse equally readable.
